svg.title: The 42 special days in a year
svg.desc: Calendar strip of 365 days in columns of 7. 13 fixed special days scattered through the year; 29 weekly entries: every 7th day from 7 to 126, then from 134 to 204 (133 skipped); 126 is listed twice.
svg.text: 365 days, one column per week of 7 days, read top to bottom then left to right
13 fixed days (126 is also a weekly one)
42 entries, 41 different days. The weekly run skips 133 and goes on one day later, so it jumps rows.
Nothing weekly after day 204: the rest of the year only has the fixed days 259 to 358.
